name: Pocket Boost
description: Lightweight optimizations that help low-end and mobile devices.

texture-cleanup.name: Free Textures After Levels
texture-cleanup.description: Releases unused textures a couple of seconds after you leave a level. Lowers memory use (fewer low-RAM crashes). The next level may load slightly slower.

particle-percent.name: Particle Density
particle-percent.description: Percent of in-level particle effects to keep. 100 = vanilla. Lower values cut CPU and GPU work in busy levels.
